title: Exports
intro: An export is a copy of the event’s lists as they are when it is made. It downloads only here, while you are signed in, and is kept until the date shown beside it.
refused: Exports are not available to your role on this event.

GUEST_LIST.name: Guest list
GUEST_LIST.about: Every household and guest with their answers, and their email and phone if you include them.

SEATING_CHART.name: Seating chart
SEATING_CHART.about: Each venue’s tables, their seats, and who sits at each.

PLACE_CARDS.name: Place cards
PLACE_CARDS.about: A card for each seated guest with their table. The PDF prints six to an A4 page, with cut guides.

CATERING_SHEET.name: Catering sheet
CATERING_SHEET.about: How many are coming to each venue, and every dietary note with the guest it belongs to.

BAR_SHEET.name: Bar sheet
BAR_SHEET.about: The drinks guests chose, for each venue.

TICKET_MANIFEST.name: Ticket manifest
TICKET_MANIFEST.about: Door codes and ticket holders, for checking people in.

XLSX.name: Spreadsheet (XLSX)
XLSX.about: To sort and filter, in Excel or Numbers.

form.title: Make an export
form.languageHelp: Headings and labels are in this language. Names, answers and notes stay as they were written.
form.contactsHelp: A file with email and phone numbers can be downloaded only while your role may see them.
form.manifest: A ticket manifest always carries door codes and buyers’ email addresses, so it needs access to guests’ contact details.

list.title: Exports made

state.retrying: That attempt didn’t work; trying again (attempt {{attempt}} of {{total}})…

failure.generation: Something went wrong while the file was being made. Make it again; if it fails again, the event may be too large for one file.
failure.stopped: The work stopped three times before the file was finished.
failure.erased: A guest’s details were erased at their request, and this file held them.

advice.support: If it fails again, contact Aveline support.
advice.access: Ask the event’s owner for access.

legacy.title: Earlier exports
legacy.intro: Before files were kept, an export was built at the moment it was downloaded. No copy of these was kept, so they can only be made again: choose the language and contact details in the form.
